counterfactual_missing_items: Absence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid
Presence of EBV/EBER in brain biopsy
decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
response.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the specific immunophenotypic profile from the brain biopsy support the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

rejected.why: Biopsy results do not support glioblastoma diagnosis
Presence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid and brain biopsy results do not support multiple sclerosis diagnosis
Brain biopsy results and absence of EBV/EBER do not support progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy diagnosis
